The independent visual trace agrees with the saved series assertion and its wireBypass=false for both components.

The prose's finite meter resistance R_0 remains a prose fact; its absence as a printed diagram label is faithful to the original.

Visible labels are Latin A and R only. All six label instances across the three previews are legible, complete and clear of component outlines.
